Validation is O(number of static probes + storage tables) and adds no request-path, database, network, or migration runtime work.
New runtime-evidence and cloud-readiness tests cover positive readiness, table/probe coverage, nonclaims, and negative overclaim/drift cases.

The contract strengthens compliance traceability for tenant-isolated durable storage on the later Oyatie Cloud substrate while preserving production database, live RLS, backup restore, cloud database, and runtime audit evidence as explicit blockers.
